roadmap.title: Prologue and shopping
roadmap.description: Finish the prologue, then buy pants, shoes, a shirt, a two-handed weapon and every app while playing the first four story operations.

roadmap.title: Middle story and races
roadmap.description: Play the middle story operations and do the races, boat, drone and eKart side operation as they open. Start the online Hold My Hand and Bounty Hunter achievements here while players are available.

roadmap.title: Closing story and side operations
roadmap.description: Finish the last story operations, then do Shadow, Ubistolen and the remaining open-world tasks.

roadmap.title: DLC and collections
roadmap.description: Play the Human Conditions and No Compromise operations and finish the ScoutX photos and all 24 Key Data.

roadmap.title: Online achievements
roadmap.description: Do the co-op, bounty hunter, invasion, DedSec event and Showd0wn achievements with other players.

achievements.description: Erase your past identity in the Blume servers
achievements.summary: Finish the prologue operation and erase your identity from the Blume servers.

steps.text: Play the prologue mission through to its end; it unlocks automatically.

achievements.description: Buy some pants after the party
achievements.summary: Buy any pair of pants after the prologue.

steps.text: Open the map, fast travel to any clothing store, and buy a pair of pants.

achievements.description: Buy a two handed weapon at the 3D printer
achievements.sortReason: Buy at the HQ printer on first visit.
achievements.summary: Purchase a two-handed weapon from the 3D printer.

steps.text: At the @loc{DedSec hacker HQ}, open the 3D printer and buy any weapon that needs both hands, like an assault rifle or a sniper rifle. Pistols do not count.

achievements.description: Buy the Gatorfeet Whine Country footwear
achievements.sortReason: Open from the start; do with the other purchases.
achievements.summary: Buy the Gatorfeet Whine Country footwear.

steps.text: Fast travel to a @loc{Plainstock} clothing store, for example in Oakland.
In the footwear category, buy the pink Gatorfeet Whine Country shoes for $65.

achievements.sortReason: Nearby ride, available from the start.

steps.text: In @loc{San Francisco}, head to the Transamerica Pyramid and board a cable car running on the street tracks. They only run in a small area, so wait for one if none is nearby.

achievements.description: Buy a shirt in the Nudle vending machine
achievements.summary: Buy a shirt from the Nudle clothing vending machine.

steps.text: Travel to the vending machine at the @loc{Nudle campus} in the south of Silicon Valley and purchase a $5 T-shirt.

guide.context: A dog always appears at @loc{Pier 39} by the restaurant when you fast travel there.

steps.text: Find a dog and pet it. Petting the same dog 10 times counts.

achievements.summary: Take a selfie in which a passer-by photobombs.

steps.text: Open the phone camera, switch to selfie mode, and wait on a sidewalk until a passer-by strikes a pose behind you. Then take the photo.

achievements.description: Drive one of the Unique Vehicles
achievements.summary: Get into and drive any one of the unique vehicles placed at fixed spots in the world.

guide.context: Each unique vehicle waits at a fixed spot, and any one counts. The @mechanic{Vehicle Directional Hack} skill takes 2 research points.

steps.text: At the @loc{Port of Oakland}, scan the area until a blue car icon appears inside a shipping container.
Climb the container crane, hack it to make a path, and reach the top.
With the @mechanic{Vehicle Directional Hack} skill, steer the car out of the container, then get in. The achievement unlocks when you enter it.
Fast travel to the @loc{Marin Yacht Club} area, take an empty boat, and drive up to a boat with a driver in it.
Hijack that boat.
Find a bus in traffic, most often in inner @loc{San Francisco}, and hijack it.

achievements.description: Collect all the Key Data hidden in the world
achievements.sortReason: 24 Key Data across the map; easier after story gear.
achievements.summary: Collect all @item{24 Key Data} hidden in the world.

guide.context: All 24 can be taken at any time after the Research app unlocks, and each saves on pickup. Opening a locked skill in the Research app marks roughly where its data is on the map. You will need the Quadcopter, the Jumper, @mechanic{Vehicle Directional Hack} and @mechanic{Environmental RC}.

collectibles.name: Alcatraz Key Data
collectibles.location: Inside the cell block, entered through the east door of the central building
collectibles.method: On level 3, send the Jumper through the cell vent and hack the data inside the wall. Unlocks Speed Boost.

collectibles.name: Yerba Buena Island Key Data
collectibles.location: Guarded complex on top of the hill, above the freeway tunnel
collectibles.method: Clear or avoid the guards. The data is next to a jeep near the north wall. Unlocks Botnet Savings: Vehicle Hacks.

collectibles.name: Kirby Cove Key Data
collectibles.location: Old fort above the cove
collectibles.method: Send the Jumper past the Sons of Ragnarok and dogs. The data is behind crates inside. Unlocks Steady Hands.

collectibles.name: Vista Point Key Data
collectibles.location: Building site below the bridge's south end (the map calls it Horseshoe Bay)
collectibles.method: Ride a motorbike up the east ramp onto the cargo containers, jump again onto the scaffold top, and drop into the section holding the data. Unlocks Expert Tinkering.

collectibles.name: Gates Houseboats Key Data
collectibles.location: Rooftop beside the Torque Rate bike shop in eastern Marin
collectibles.method: Hack the forklift, lift a crate into the corner, then climb the forklift, the crate and the roof to reach the data. Needs Vehicle Directional Hack.

collectibles.name: Prescott Key Data
collectibles.location: Small gang yard north of downtown Oakland
collectibles.method: Run in and take the data beside the small wall in the middle, or send the Jumper after a Quadcopter scout. Unlocks Fast Trigger Finger.

collectibles.name: Jack London Square Key Data
collectibles.location: Roof of the building behind the Italian restaurant
collectibles.method: Take the stairs in the alley beside the restaurant. The data is in the ctOS operations room in the south corner of the roof.

collectibles.name: Elmhurst Key Data
collectibles.location: Sons of Ragnarok yard east of Jack London Square
collectibles.method: Take the data from under the canopy. A guard dog patrols, so the Jumper is the safe way in. Unlocks Gang War.

collectibles.name: Cliff House Key Data
collectibles.location: Rear yard and balcony of the Cliff House on the west coast
collectibles.method: Park a van beside the lowest roof, climb up, and drop the Jumper to the balcony to grab the data. Unlocks Target Weakness.

collectibles.name: Coit Tower Key Data
collectibles.location: Alley one block south of Coit Tower
collectibles.method: The data sits beneath an awning on the final deck of the alley. Unlocks Strong Grip.

collectibles.name: Chinatown Key Data
collectibles.location: Alley in the north-west of Chinatown
collectibles.method: Climb the ladder by the yellow garage door, unlock the ctOS panel, and fly the Quadcopter into the vent to hack the data. Unlocks Massive Vehicle Hack.

collectibles.name: Embarcadero Center Key Data
collectibles.location: Underground ctOS garage with three guards
collectibles.method: Deal with the guards and take the data beside the workbench. Unlocks Engine Override.

collectibles.name: Ferry Building Key Data
collectibles.location: Tower of the Ferry Building on the east coast
collectibles.method: Fly the Quadcopter to the tower and hack the antenna on its walls. Unlocks Remote Gadgets.

collectibles.name: Fort Point Key Data
collectibles.location: West wall of the Fort Point building under the Golden Gate Bridge
collectibles.method: Solve the node puzzle on the bridge with the Quadcopter to open the junction box; the data waits in the shed. Unlocks Botnet Savings: City Hacking.

collectibles.name: Lombard Street Key Data
collectibles.location: Roof of the building beside the one under construction, south of Lombard Street
collectibles.method: Fly the Quadcopter under the rooftop deck and hack the data. Unlocks Tweaked Blast.

collectibles.name: New Dawn Facility Key Data
collectibles.location: Gazebo near the cliff edge at the back of the compound from the False Profits operation
collectibles.method: Use the Jumper through the wall facing the water, or sneak along the fence, and take the data. Unlocks Security System Shutdown.

collectibles.name: Nudle Park Key Data
collectibles.location: Fenced lot by the stadium
collectibles.method: With Environmental RC, drive the forklift to move the pallets from the trailer, then take the data inside. Unlocks Keen Eye.

collectibles.name: SFMOMA Key Data
collectibles.location: Alley behind the museum
collectibles.method: With Vehicle Directional Hack, back the van out of the container, climb into the trailer, and take the data behind the rear door. Unlocks Chopper Retreat Exploit.

collectibles.name: Sutro Tower Key Data
collectibles.location: Small shed at the base of the tower grounds
collectibles.method: Drive the Jumper along the left side to the shed and through the hole at the base of its wall. Unlocks Expert RC Engineering.

collectibles.name: Crystal Springs Dam Key Data
collectibles.location: Construction yard garage roof
collectibles.method: With Environmental RC, lower the crane basket, ride it over the garage roof, and detonate the gas tank to break the boards. Drop in and take the data. Unlocks Electro Shock Optimization.

collectibles.name: Galilei Key Data
collectibles.location: Fortified corner south of the campus
collectibles.method: Climb the shipping container with the Jumper, jump the fence, unlock the ctOS box, then climb the operations building and hack the data at the top of the radio tower with the Quadcopter. Unlocks Explosive Optimization.

collectibles.name: Palo Alto Key Data
collectibles.location: Rear of Palo Alto City Hall
collectibles.method: Move the boxes with a forklift or hop them with the Jumper, unlock the shed console, then follow the signal to the roof with the Quadcopter. Unlocks Enhanced Spring.

collectibles.name: Stanford University Key Data
collectibles.location: Tower at the centre of the campus
collectibles.method: Climb the tower base and open the rear duct with the Jumper. Solve the node circuit, moving the two vans behind the tower, then take the data in the front room. Unlocks Stun Amp Up.

collectibles.name: Swan Levitt Observatory Key Data
collectibles.location: Observatory building with the large antenna dish
collectibles.method: Hack open the gate, sneak to the back, and climb the ladder on the antenna support. The data is at the north end of the platform. Unlocks Botnet Savings: Personal Devices.

guide.context: The police stand-off in the @loc{Looking Glass} operation is a good time to start. The door lock wears off after a few seconds, so power it down and up again if police wait outside.

steps.text: Kill police until your wanted level reaches 5 stars.
Drive into underground parking garages and close each door behind you with the door hack.
In the last garage, power the door down so no one can enter.
Stay out of sight until the radar turns yellow, then for one more minute.

achievements.description: Drive 4 km in the world while driving the Merengue from Elek Motors
achievements.summary: Drive 4 km in a Merengue from Elek Motors.

steps.text: Get a Merengue, either by paying $43,125 at @loc{Total Motors} or by taking one from the street.
Drive 4 km, for example along a highway, then stop. The achievement unlocks when the car stops.

achievements.description: Do a stealth takedown on 30 enemies
achievements.sortReason: Counts up during normal stealth play.

guide.context: Restricted areas respawn their enemies, which makes them good for finishing the count.

steps.text: Sneak up behind unaware enemies and use the melee takedown 30 times, in missions or in restricted areas.

achievements.description: Do a 140 meters long jump while driving a vehicle
achievements.sortReason: Needs a fast bike and the right ramp.
achievements.summary: Make a 140 m jump while driving a vehicle.

steps.text: Buy the Sayonara motorbike at an @loc{Auto Elite} dealership and have it delivered.
Line up a straight run at a long ramp and jump.
If you fall short, use @mechanic{Engine Override} nitro for more speed.

achievements.sortReason: Needs a cheap boat from the Yacht Club.

steps.text: At the @loc{Marin Yacht Club}, buy a boat; the cheapest costs $3,000.
Start the race at the green race icon and finish it. Your place does not matter.

achievements.sortReason: Robots are in Haum Sweet Haum and on the Nudle campus.

guide.context: Robots also appear in the @loc{Haum Sweet Haum} operation; replay that mission if you missed one.

steps.text: Travel to the @loc{Nudle campus} in the south of Silicon Valley and hack any robot driving around it.

achievements.description: Make 3 jumps in a row aboard a vehicle
achievements.sortReason: Usually unlocks by itself during normal driving.
achievements.summary: Get a vehicle airborne three times in a row.

steps.text: Drive off-road or over hills and bumps until the vehicle leaves the ground three times in a row.

achievements.description: Take a picture of someone vomiting
achievements.sortReason: Random spawn; can take a while.
achievements.summary: Take a picture of someone vomiting.

guide.context: They appear at random and any time of day works, so it may take a while.

steps.text: In Oakland, walk the pier by the bar at @loc{Jack London Square} and watch for drunk or ill-looking people.
When one vomits, take a photo of them.

achievements.description: Travel 200 meters on top of a car by hacking it
achievements.summary: Travel 200 m on top of a car using the vehicle hack.

steps.text: Buy @mechanic{Vehicle Directional Hack} for 2 research points.
Climb onto the roof of a car on a long straight road and steer it with the hack for 200 m.

guide.context: Events are Upload Virus, Hack the Hacker and Eliminate Car Driver. They appear at random, and more often when both players stay close together and at the start of a session. In a private four-player party you can instead pick a DedSec activity such as The Virus from the multiplayer menu and repeat it.

steps.text: Go online with a partner and drive or walk around the open world until a DedSec event notice appears.
Finish the event. Repeat until you have done 5.

achievements.description: Neutralize 1 Hunter in Bounty Hunter mode
achievements.summary: Take down one Hunter during a Bounty Hunter session.

guide.context: If nobody joins, make sure all online preferences are on, or start a level 5 police chase to attract hunters.

steps.text: Open the phone, choose Multiplayer, then Bounty Hunter, then Trigger Bounty.
When other players join as hunters, kill one of them.

achievements.description: Successfully neutralize 5 fugitives in Bounty Hunter
achievements.summary: Take down five fugitives while playing Bounty Hunter.

guide.context: A kill by anyone else does not count. If the objective on screen does not name a target to neutralize, cancel and choose Bounty Hunter again.

steps.text: Open the phone, choose Multiplayer, then Bounty Hunter, then Find a Target.
Kill the player the police are chasing yourself. Repeat until you have 5 kills.

achievements.description: Successfully complete an online Co-op Operation

steps.text: Open the phone and choose Multiplayer, then Online Co-Op, then Launch.
Finish a co-op operation, marked with purple icons on the map.

achievements.description: Use the "Call the cops" hack on the donut-disguised man in Haight-Ashbury
achievements.summary: Have the police called on the man dressed as a donut in Haight-Ashbury with the Call the Cops hack.

guide.context: He does not appear at night.

steps.text: Buy @mechanic{APB: Suspect Located} and the Botnet upgrade, which cost 6 research points together.
In daytime, visit the donut shop beside the Dye Dude kiosk in @loc{Haight-Ashbury}.
Use Call the Cops on the man in the donut costume and wait for police to arrest him.
Open the phone, choose Multiplayer, then Hacking Invasion, or go to a purple Hacking Invasion icon.
Stay hidden until the hack bar reaches 100%.

achievements.sortReason: Take 25 photos across the open world.

guide.context: There are 57 sights and only 25 are needed. The man in the donut costume counts as one.

steps.text: Open the ScoutX app to see the nearest sight and its reference image.
Photograph the sight with the phone camera. Repeat until you have 25.

guide.context: The cheapest cars are in the Standard category and some cost only $2,000.

steps.text: Save about $269,000, then buy the 25 cheapest cars at @loc{Total Motors} dealerships.
Begin the @item{eKart Challenge} side operation from its Silicon Valley icon; it opens once Cyber Driver is done.
Win the races and find the upgrades. The achievement unlocks with the second upgrade.

achievements.description: Buy all the apps in the App Shop
achievements.summary: Buy every app in the App Shop.

steps.text: Open the phone's App Shop and buy each app that still shows a price.

achievements.sortReason: Needs the drone from the HQ printer.

steps.text: Buy the drone for $67,500 at the HQ 3D printer.
Talk to the man with the laptop at the drone icon near HQ.
Finish a drone race. Your place does not matter.

achievements.sortReason: Race icons open after early story.

steps.text: Go to a green motorbike icon on the map and finish the race. Your place does not matter.
Scan the informant inside the restaurant in the Tenderloin and Chinatown area.
Follow the markers to the container yard and finish the operation.
Play the story operation Hack teh World to its end; it unlocks automatically.
Play the story operation Looking Glass to its end; it unlocks automatically.
Play the story operation False Profits to its end; it unlocks automatically.
Play the story operation Cyber Driver to its end; it unlocks automatically.
Play the story operation Haum Sweet Haum to its end; it unlocks automatically.
Play the story operation Limp Nudle to its end; it unlocks automatically.
After Limp Nudle, start $911 from the DedSec app on the phone or from an orange Operation Intel icon.
Finish the operation.
Play the story operation W4tched to its end; it unlocks automatically.

achievements.description: Finish Operation: Eye for An Eye
achievements.summary: Finish Operation Eye for An Eye.

steps.text: Play the story operation Eye for An Eye to its end; it unlocks automatically.
Play the story operation Hacker War to its end; it unlocks automatically.

achievements.description: Finish Operation: Power to the Sheeple
achievements.summary: Finish Operation Power to the Sheeple.

steps.text: Play the story operation Power to the Sheeple to its end; it unlocks automatically.
Play the story operation Robot Wars to its end; it unlocks automatically.
Play the story operation Shanghaied to its end; it unlocks automatically.
Near Stanford University, find Elliott Chen, the Ubisoft marketing director, standing by a liquor store and hack his phone.
Head to the Ubisoft car park, stack up the crates to reach the roof, and download the camera footage from the ctOS box.

achievements.description: Trigger the hack of the century
achievements.summary: Start the final story operation, Hack the World, after the other main operations.

steps.text: Finish the other story operations, then start the final main operation.
Play the Bad Medicine operation from the Human Conditions DLC to its end.
Play the Automata operation from the Human Conditions DLC to its end.
Play the Caustic Progress operation from the Human Conditions DLC to its end.

guide.context: The final mission may need many tasks first, and a partner makes this faster. Repeating missions you have already done can help if it does not open.

steps.text: From the DedSec app, complete the Off the Hook co-op tasks until the final mission opens.
Play the final mission.
Play the Moscow Gambit operation from the No Compromise DLC to its end.

achievements.description: Reach the maximum win streak bonus in Showd0wn
achievements.summary: Reach the top win-streak bonus in Showd0wn.

guide.context: Solo queueing can work but is unreliable. If the achievement does not unlock after 4 wins, keep winning; some players needed more.

steps.text: Form two teams of two. Each pair should be friends only with each other on the Ubisoft Connect friends list, then restart the launcher and the game.
Everyone fast travels to @loc{Alcatraz}.
Both teams queue for Showd0wn until you land in the same match.
Let each team take turns winning 4 matches in a row. Do not leave the queue between matches.
